evals.prompt: Convert a defect list into an actionable revision plan with per-subquestion scoping.
evals.expected_output: Success returns revision_plan.json mapping each defect to a source file and a local fix.
assertions: maps every defect to at least one concrete fix step
scopes each fix to the affected subquestion or section
avoids a full-paper rewrite for a single localized defect
records the target source file and acceptance criteria per fix
